oracle_policy: Source truth is frozen from upstream published fixture expectations, not from support_learning detector output. Unknown page-level counts remain null. Capability expectation is separate and may never change source truth.

cases.oracle_evidence: Camelot quickstart/fixture publishes one 7x7 ruled table. PDF M2 v1 currently classifies its topology as complex/merged and must not emit a partial table.

Camelot lattice regression explicitly asserts two tables for twotables_2.pdf. M2 v1 does not yet expose a defensible candidate for this page, so this remains a recall observation rather than a fail-closed prohibition.
Camelot lattice regression uses row_span_1.pdf as a row-spanning table fixture. Row spans are explicitly outside PDF M2 v1 capability.
Camelot lattice regression uses column_span_2.pdf as a column-spanning table fixture. Column spans are explicitly outside PDF M2 v1 capability.
Image-only fixture is a hard negative for native-text M2 table structure.

PyMuPDF test_strict_lines uses lines_strict on this fixture, and test_markdown publishes the complete 5x3 extracted table content. Upstream does not assert the total number of tables on the page, so page-level count is intentionally unknown.
